# Your personal newsletter. Written by AI, just for you. Free.

Tell us what you care about. We'll write and deliver a personalized newsletter to your inbox — on your schedule.

## Questions

### Is it really free?

Yes. Briefed is completely free. No paid tier, no upsells.

### How personal is it?

Each issue is generated for you, based on the description you gave us and any refinements you send later. Two subscribers never get the same newsletter.

### How do I refine what I get?

Just reply to any newsletter with what you liked, disliked, or want more of. We'll fold it into the next issue.

### How do I unsubscribe?

One click at the bottom of any issue. Instant, no questions.
